purpose: Teach: 親しま/似通っ/嗚呼/取り敢えず/ながめ/きびしい/ようするに/よーく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは、ご近所の方に親しまれてらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather was really loved by the neighbors, wasn't he.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Gentle recognition of loss. Slight pause before speaking, as if gathering the weight of memory. Warm maternal tone, not questioning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんとお父さんの笑い方が、似通ってるね
lines.en: Mom, the way Grandpa laughed... it's like Dad's laugh.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not a complaint or question. Small, genuine noticing. Pause between thoughts. The careful way a child speaks when he's seeing something true for the first time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、嗚呼、夕焼けがきれいね
lines.en: Sho, oh... the sunset really is beautiful, isn't it.
lines.style: Gaze turned outward. Breathing slows. The kind of wistfulness that comes from watching light change and time move. Not sadness—just presence with what is passing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、取り敢えず宿題から終わらせるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to finish my homework first.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Not performing maturity—genuinely trying to help. A small child being small and clear about what he can do. No rush, just focus.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭の景色をながめるのも素敵な時間ね
lines.en: Sho, looking out at the garden like this... it's a lovely way to spend time, isn't it.
lines.style: Validating his quiet presence. Speaking as if they're both noticing the same peaceful thing together. Not rushing him. Gentle permission to be still.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんはきびしいけど優しい人だったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was strict, but he was kind too.
lines.style: Small voice holding two things at once—the firmness and the gentleness. Not defending, just remembering accurately. The way a child honors someone by seeing them whole.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ようするに、お父さんは翔くんが大事なのよ
lines.en: Sho, what I'm saying is... your dad treasures you.
lines.style: Cutting through to what matters. Direct, not elaborate. A mother translating what her own father's sternness really meant. Steady eye contact in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、よーく耳をすませて聞いてるよ
lines.style: Small but present. Not performing attention—actually giving it. Quiet confirmation that he hears not just words but what she means underneath.
